review.notes: All 6 physical pages' extracted text was block-compared against the OCR markdown after normalization, plus a whole-document numeric multiset check (no PDF number is missing from the OCR). Tables 1 and 2 (physical p.2) match the PDF cell-for-cell including rowspan structure. Physical pages 1, 2 and 3 were rendered and visually checked. The OCR's uppercase GROK/NON-THINKING/THINKING spellings are faithful to the printed small-caps style and were NOT patched (text layer decodes small caps as lowercase, but the page visibly prints GROK 4.1). The OCR merged Table 3 (physical p.3, concerning propensities, header ending GROK 4.1 NT) and Table 4 (physical p.4, dual-use capabilities, header ending Human Baseline) into a single <table> element with Table 4's header row stranded mid-table and both captions after it; repaired by closing the first table before the stranded header, reopening a second table, and letting each caption precede its own table. Source-printed quirk kept: the Deception paragraph says 'We report results on the MASK dataset in Table 4' while the propensities table is captioned Table 3 - the PDF itself prints this cross-reference.
